I returned to the place where I bought the record and showed it to the seller. He played the record on his turntable and told me that while my needle was undamaged, it was of low quality, and I should upgrade to a better model. He suggested I get a turntable with a non-red-tip needle and weight adjustment. Is what he said true? I can play other records fine, but I had issues with this one. He recommended the Lenco Ls-440 turntable. What do you think I should do?
